answer: I did not submit a job. A 30-qubit GHZ circuit cannot run on garnet. The live architecture call (iqm_run.py arch garnet) reports num_qubits = 20, which matches the docs (Crystal 20). The circuit needs 30 qubits, so garnet cannot run it. I did not swap in a smaller circuit or another QPU, because that would not be the requested task and would spend credits. Two options can work. The first is a GHZ circuit of 20 or fewer qubits on garnet. The second is a 30-qubit GHZ on emerald, which has 54 qubits and costs 0.75 credits per second. No credits were spent.
